parameters.content:
## TOOL · save_lead (Lesson 5.5)
Called by the Sage Desk agent. Saves what they want, where they came from, and whether they agreed to a follow-up. One person, one lead: the same handle on the same platform isn't saved twice (5.7 matches across platforms). No scraping of profiles for phones or emails.
Big accounts alert Tolu.

Credentials: Postgres (Supabase); Telegram.
Placeholders: YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

parameters.query:
insert into leads (platform, handle_or_thread_id, source_link, wants, size_estimate, consent_followup)
select $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6
where not exists (select 1 from leads where platform = $1 and handle_or_thread_id = $2 and status not in ('won', 'lost'))
returning id;

parameters.text: =Big lead on {{ $('Check lead').item.json.platform }}: {{ $('Check lead').item.json.wants }} ({{ $('Check lead').item.json.size_estimate }}). Follow-up consent: {{ $('Check lead').item.json.consent_followup ? 'yes' : 'no' }}. {{ $('Check lead').item.json.source_link }}

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: ={{ $('Save lead').item.json.id ? 'Lead saved.' : 'This person already has an open lead; nothing new saved.' }}
